name: project-archive
description: Selected Work - Project Archive Web & Mobile App

scripts.build: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.rmSync('www', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html', 'style.css', 'script.js', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); fs.cpSync('icons', 'www/icons', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('ping', 'www/ping', { recursive: true });"
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap run android
